summary: Iteration 126: SEO System Testing. All 18 backend tests passed. Product SEO endpoint returns proper title (55-65 chars), description (140-160 chars), and content (400-800 words with H1/H2 sections). City pages return unique content with city-specific SEO. Internal linking works correctly.

minor.issue: Title format '{Product} in {City} | Industrial Supplier | UdyogConnect' falls back to shorter version when exceeding 65 chars. This is expected behavior per SEO best practices.

frontend_issues.notes: Backend-only testing as requested. No frontend testing performed.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ GET /api/products/{slug}/seo returns seoTitle (60 chars), seoDescription (152 chars), seoContent (576 words)
✓ seoContent has all required H1/H2 sections: Suppliers, Specifications, Applications, How to Buy, Suppliers by City, Why Choose UdyogConnect
✓ GET /api/products/{slug}/city/{city} returns city-specific title (54 chars), description (153 chars), seoContent (442 words)
✓ City page title format: '{Product Name} in {City} | UdyogConnect' (shortened from full format to fit 65 char limit)
✓ City SEO content is UNIQUE - different from main product page (city-specific intro, pricing, advantages)
✓ City page has internal links back to main product page and category page
✓ GET /api/products/{slug}/cities returns list of cities with sellers (Mumbai: 2 sellers)
✓ Public search (GET /api/search) only returns active listings, excludes draft
✓ Product update auto-regenerates weak SEO via should_regenerate_seo() check
✓ seo_service.py correctly implements title truncation for 65 char limit
✓ city_seo_service.py generates unique 400+ word content per city
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 126 tested the upgraded SEO system. Key findings: (1) Product SEO endpoint at /api/products/{slug}/seo returns proper seoTitle (55-65 chars), seoDescription (140-160 chars), and seoContent (400-800 words with H1/H2 sections). (2) City page endpoint at /api/products/{slug}/city/{city} returns unique city-specific content - NOT duplicate of main product page. (3) Cities list endpoint at /api/products/{slug}/cities returns cities with seller counts. (4) Title format uses fallback logic when full format exceeds 65 chars. (5) Test product: industrial-electric-motor-5hp-test-category-supplier-india has 2 sellers in Mumbai. (6) All SEO content generation is deterministic (no AI dependency).
